pages.text: $(bold)Mercury — The Burning World$()$(br)Mobs: $(bold){{dim ad_astra:mercury difficulty}}$() the vanilla strength, like every Tier 4 world$(br)Death penalty: $(bold){{dim ad_astra:mercury death}}$()$(br2)Mercury's day/night cycle is $(italic)lethal$(). The sun-facing side deals continuous fire damage. The dark side deals extreme cold damage. Survival requires constant awareness of the terminator line.

$(bold)The Terminator Line$()$(br)The boundary between Mercury's sunlit and dark sides is the only survivable zone without full environmental protection. Smart explorers follow this line as the planet rotates.$(br2)$(bold)Day Side (Sun):$() Continuous fire damage. Heatward enchantment essential.$(br)$(bold)Night Side (Dark):$() Extreme cold damage. Frostward enchantment essential.$(br2)Having $(italic)both$() enchantments is ideal.

$(bold)Purpose$()$(br)Mercury contains high-value heat-resistant ores and mercury-specific metals. These materials contribute to Tier 4 Rocket construction.$(br2)$(bold)Structures$()$(br)Ancient solar collection arrays and heat-sealed structures dot the surface. They contain rare loot unique to Mercury.

$(bold)Planetary Rock Extraction$()$(br)Crush $(bold)Mercury Stone$() in Create Crushing Wheels or a Thermal Pulverizer to extract:$(br)• $(bold)Solar Crystal$() (20%) — crystallized solar energy$(br)• $(bold)Rare Earth Dust$() (20%) — high-tech crafting$(br)• Gold Nuggets (35%)$(br2)The Thermal Pulverizer gives slightly better odds.

$(bold)Stellar Shield Enchantment$()$(br)Mercury mobs have a $(bold)12% chance$() to drop an enchanted book of $(bold)Stellar Shield$() (max level 3). This armor enchantment:$(br)• Grants solar radiation resistance$(br)• Reduces fire damage by 33% per level on planets$(br)• Negates Mercury day-side fire damage at level 3$(br2)Pairs well with Thermal Regulation for full Mercury survival.$(br2)$(bold)Next: farm both enchantments to level 3 — you'll want them on Venus too.$()
